requirements.name: python3-matplotlib
requirements.purpose: Figure rendering and PNG/PDF/SVG export through the headless Agg backend.

requirements.name: python3-numpy
requirements.purpose: Numeric array backend for matplotlib and the bundled palette and style tooling.

requirements.name: python3-pil
requirements.purpose: Raster deliverable inspection and RGB TIFF flattening in figure export.

requirements.name: python3-pypdf
requirements.purpose: PDF deliverable inspection: page geometry and embedded fonts.

requirements.name: fontconfig
requirements.purpose: Font discovery and the Debian FreeType library that rasterizes faces; every glyph render claim runs against it.

requirements.name: fonts-noto-cjk
requirements.purpose: CJK glyph coverage for chart labels; optional so non-CJK figures stay honest without it, and the guest FreeType probe gates any CJK claim.
